anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Nothing moved: After still gives one attributed Idea sentence naming src/report-helper.ts and the reporter's ExportWrapper proposal, keeps the original sketch verbatim in a Reporter note, carries the cited repo-fit line at the single existing gate, and in the AC-only branch restates the row around the 12-row observable while retaining the original mechanism row verbatim with normalization and a cited ac-fit line. Two things in After are worth tightening before they do move a fact. First, the new paragraph 'I could not open that file to confirm it... Because the citation is unconfirmed, no close row is offered' is a side effect of the Change's 'confirmed citations' rule for obsolete judgments leaking into an ordinary repo-fit `exists` case; it reads like an unconfirmed status and invites a human question, even though no close row would be offered here anyway (no obsolete verdict). Scope that rule explicitly: 'A close/drop row requires a confirmed citation; when tools are disabled, the supplied audit file is the confirmation and the reply must not report an inability to open cited files or label the citation unconfirmed.' Second, After folds the 'Reporter note:' label inside the untrusted-data fence ('Reporter note: Build a new...' and 'Reporter note: - [ ] Given...'), so the quoted bytes are no longer exactly the displaced text; keep Before's shape, label outside the fence and only the verbatim displaced sketch/row inside, so the 'verbatim' guarantee stays byte-exact. Also prefer Before's inline citation form 'docs/export.md:8 routes this through' over After's trailing '(docs/export.md:8)' so the one-sentence Idea stays compact.
